text:
marta: FYI — DAST run on staging shows ~120 new findings since yesterday's RBAC role update. Most look like 401/403 auth failures and a bunch of noisy 'auth bypass' results. Anyone seeing the same auditlog spike?
josh: I saw the CI alert this morning. Correlates with the role rename we did in infra yesterday — scanner service account may have lost the `staging-scanner` binding.
lina: Was there a KMS rotation window at the same time? I remember a scheduled rotation yesterday afternoon.
marta: Logs point to a lot of `token: decryption failed` from scanner-worker instances. Not purely HTTP-level auth failures.
marta: ```
[2025-05-12T10:12:23Z] scanner-worker-1 ERROR decrypt: kms: access denied for key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/scanner-key
[2025-05-12T10:12:24Z] scanner-worker-2 WARN  request=GET /app/login 403 "unauthenticated" user=\"-\"
[2025-05-12T10:12:33Z] scanner-worker-1 ERROR refresh-token: vault: token not found for sa=scanner-sa@staging
```
ci-bot: DAST job #458 posted: 403-heavy -> created alert (severity: medium). See job logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/458
ronald: If scanner requests are unauthenticated we should change the premerge gating to advisory until we triage. We can't block releases on noisy auth-related hits.
josh: I'll check IAM bindings + keystore policy. Quick check I'll run: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy scanner-key --project=redwood` and `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
lina: Also verify Vault lease/TTL for the scanner service tokens — last change lowered TTL to 1h and I think some workers didn't pick up refresh logic.
marta: Assigning triage owner: @josh. Please open INF ticket with evidence + list of affected runs. If root cause is RBAC/KMS we escalate to security and infra.
josh: On it. ETA ~45m. I'll post findings here.
marta: :thumbsup: Include the RBAC PR diff link and the KMS rotation window in the ticket.
josh: Opened INF-1724: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1724 — attaching run logs and the `gcloud` outputs as they come in.
marta: For now I've set the staging DAST gate to advisory (no block) and added a note in the release checklist. If anyone sees production anomalies, flag immediately.
josh: First pass shows the `staging-scanner` role was removed in PR #3245 (infra/iam) during the rename; also found Vault errors pointing to stale service tokens. Fix plan: rebind role, rotate scanner key ACL to include scanner-sa, and add a healthcheck that validates token refresh.
lina: I'll add a test to devex scaffolding that simulates KMS rotation and ensures scanner retries refresh tokens.
ronald: Good — once triage completes, let's run a targeted DAST on a small staging app to confirm noise cleared before turning the gate back to blocking.
marta: Thanks team. Please keep this thread updated. We'll capture postmortem if fix touches RBAC/KMS or SDLC gating.
